proposals.evidence: prompts/features/07-prompts-output.md names the prompt file that is compiled and its generated output.
proposals.rationale: A prompt is a rule_file with kind 'prompt'; a separate object would duplicate rule_file.

proposals.evidence: prompts/01-contract.md 5 compares the prose a model writes with the prose a human wrote.
proposals.rationale: Prose is text held in a rule's or an output's text field; it has no identity of its own.

proposals.evidence: prompts/01-contract.md states a rule's strength with one of two words.
proposals.rationale: Strength is a field of rule, not an entity the model tracks.

proposals.evidence: prompts/how-to-write-tasks.md 2 separates a task into named sections.
proposals.rationale: A section is a part of a task or a feature; it is modeled as task_section or feature_section.

proposals.evidence: sources/browser/index.html draws the studio as a step rail.
proposals.rationale: A step is page state; it has no identity or operations in the domain.

proposals.evidence: sources/browser/index.html gives each step one panel.
proposals.rationale: A panel is a view element, not domain data.

proposals.evidence: sources/browser/index.html groups a panel's content into tabs.
proposals.rationale: A tab is a view element, not domain data.

proposals.evidence: prompts/03-conventions.md 6.3 names the raw caches a pipeline preserves.
proposals.rationale: A cache is a host artifact with no modeled fields.

proposals.evidence: prompts/how-to-write-tasks.md 8 uses a mount as a host resource.
proposals.rationale: A mount is a host resource, covered by the host object's resource field.

proposals.evidence: prompts/how-to-write-tasks.md 8 mentions creating a volume as host work.
proposals.rationale: A volume is a host resource, covered by the host object.

proposals.evidence: prompts/how-to-write-tasks.md 8 mentions restarting a service as host work.
